name: hackernews-data-api
title: Hacker News Public Reads
description: Read-only access to public Hacker News data: front-page and category feeds, single-item fetch with bounded comment threading, user profiles, and term search. Requests use Bearer workspace-key authentication or truthful x402 v2 payment negotiation when the service returns HTTP 402. No submit, vote, comment, favorite, login, or other mutation is supported.
surface_status: This package documents nine stable, read-only GET operations with bounded requests and normalized v1 responses.
The public routes are stable capability identifiers for agent tool bindings.
No availability, uptime, latency, success-rate, or payment-settlement claim is made; example payloads are illustrative fixtures.

source_of_truth.purpose: Public sanitized provenance for the Hacker News read-skill package and its release artifacts.

distribution.note: Registry status is verified independently after publication.

capabilities.summary: One Hacker News item with bounded comment thread

modes.name: bearer_workspace_key
modes.claim: successful access only when upstream returns 200

modes.name: x402_v2_negotiation
modes.trigger: request without Authorization header on a metered route
modes.settlement: X-PAYMENT header carrying a signed x402 v2 payload
modes.claim: requirements advertisement, not settlement or successful paid access

auth.claim: exactly two access modes exist; no third mode is supported or claimed
